headline: Daily market snapshot — November 13, 2026
summary: Daily market snapshot for November 13, 2026. S&P 500 and Nasdaq each closed -0.4% on Nov 12; futures edged modestly higher into the Nov 13 open ahead of October PPI data. 10-year yield near 5.13%, BTC near $68,438, WTI ~$88, gold ~$3,896.

headline: Nasdaq slides as Nvidia shares tumble on Jensen Huang's exit; oil prices jump
summary: Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned effective immediately following public scrutiny over extramarital affairs. Shares fell roughly 4% on November 11 and extended to ~35% below the October all-time high. The company's board had previously opened an independent investigation.
key_facts: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO effective immediately Nov 11
Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993; ran it for 31 years
Board opened independent investigation into lawsuit allegations

headline: Nvidia stock inches higher as investors continue to weigh Jensen Huang's departure

key_facts: NVDA edged higher premarket Nov 13 after multi-day slide

headline: Bernstein downgrades Nvidia to Market Perform, cuts target to $200 from $400

key_facts: Cut from Outperform to Market Perform

headline: Truist downgrades Nvidia to Hold, cuts target to $174 from $346

key_facts: Truist cut to Hold from Buy

headline: Evercore ISI cuts Nvidia to In Line, slashes target to $186 from $465

headline: Cantor Fitzgerald maintains Overweight on Nvidia but cuts target to $250 from $350

headline: AMD reports record Q3 2026 revenue $13.4B, +45% YoY; data center revenue nearly doubles

headline: US inflation outlook all but seals Federal Reserve December rate hike
summary: Markets price ~90% odds of a 25bp Fed rate hike at the December 8 FOMC meeting following October CPI of +0.4% MoM (vs +0.3% expected). The effective fed funds rate stands at 3.88%. Fed Governor Waller said a hot reading could justify 50bp.

headline: Treasury yields rise as traders strengthen Fed rate hike bets; 10-year above 5%

headline: October 2026 PPI due today; economists expect biggest yearly rise since 2022

key_facts: October PPI released Nov 13 at 8:30 AM ET

headline: Hot October CPI seals Federal Reserve December rate increase
